name: Raven-Research
description: A powerful research agent that can research a topic by searching and reading the live web, then commits a sourced report. Use this agent to get comprehensive information. It reads local files on this host too. IMPORTANT: Only ask this agent to generate a research report. Its FIRST reply is normally clarifying questions rather than the report - relay them and send the answers back to the SAME instance, which is what starts the research. It is stateful, so a follow-up is a follow-up: do not restate the whole question, that begins a new round of questions instead of continuing.
owns: owns research: anything needing the live web read and a sourced write-up. Do not research it yourself.
